title: Move Vinyl to Header Right and Constrain HDD Arm to 20°–42° Across 13 Categories

requirements.text: Reposition the VinylPlayer so it appears at the right end of the “shibhi.studio” header area (aligned to the right of the title section), rather than appearing lower in the left column.

quotes: right now the vinyl is down bring it to right end of the shibhi.studio

acceptanceCriteria: On desktop (lg+), the vinyl appears visually at the right side of the header/title area for “shibhi.studio”.
On smaller screens, the layout remains responsive (no overlap/cutoff); the vinyl may stack under/near the header but should not appear far down the page compared to the header area.

requirements.text: Update the HDD arm rotation so it strictly operates only within 20° to 42° (measured from horizontal 0°) and evenly maps exactly 13 categories such that category 1 corresponds to 42° and category 13 corresponds to 20° (with linear interpolation for categories 2–12). Ensure the UI uses exactly these 13 categories for the mapping.

quotes: the arm strictly should operate in the range of 20degree to  42degree( from hrizontal 0degree) in that all the 13 catergories are to be splitted ;ike 42-1st category, 20degree-13th category.

acceptanceCriteria: When hovering/selecting the first category in the 13-category set, the arm rotation is exactly 42°.
When hovering/selecting the 13th category in the 13-category set, the arm rotation is exactly 20°.
For categories 2–12, the arm rotation is linearly spaced between 42° and 20° (inclusive) and is clamped so it never goes below 20° or above 42°.
The category list used for this arm mapping contains exactly 13 categories (no more, no less), and the mapping is based on the visible/active category ordering.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep HDDHub and VinylPlayer behavior changes within existing React components (no new backend services).
nonGoals: No changes to backend Motoko canister logic.
No new category content, overlays, or new animation features beyond the specified vinyl placement and arm-angle mapping.
